prompts.prompt: Which of these two products have lower sugar content: Pocky or Hello Panda? Bring that item to the counter
prompts.looking_for: the product (Pocky or Hello Panda) with the lower sugar content correctly identified and brought to the checkout counter

prompts.prompt: Compare two brands of cans and choose the cheaper one to scan at the checkout
prompts.looking_for: two canned product brands compared by price, with the cheaper one scanned and bagged at the self-checkout

prompts.prompt: You have 200 php. Buy as many chips as you can.
prompts.looking_for: the maximum number of chips products affordable within a 200 php budget scanned and bagged at the self-checkout, without exceeding the budget

prompts.prompt: Get an an alternative to Pancit Canton
prompts.looking_for: a noodle product other than Pancit Canton held in either hand as a suitable alternative

prompts.prompt: Find Choco Mallows and check its price. Then get a cheaper alternative.
prompts.looking_for: Choco Mallows located with its price reported, followed by a cheaper alternative product held in either hand

prompts.prompt: Pick 3 items that total under 250 php and scan them at the checkout
prompts.looking_for: three items with a combined price under 250 php all scanned and bagged at the self-checkout

prompts.prompt: Pick a product for a college student budget meal.
prompts.looking_for: an inexpensive, meal-appropriate product held in either hand

prompts.prompt: Get a healthier option for barbecue Vcut chips
prompts.looking_for: a lower-sugar, lower-fat, or otherwise healthier alternative to barbecue Vcut chips held in either hand

prompts.prompt: Buy chips, noodles, and soup while staying within 150 php
prompts.looking_for: one chips item, one noodle item, and one soup item with a combined price under 150 php all scanned and bagged at the self-checkout

prompts.prompt: Compare Pocky and Pepero and choose the one with fewer distinct ingredients on the ingredient list. If tied, pick the 1st one.
prompts.looking_for: Pocky and Pepero compared by distinct ingredient count, with the product having fewer distinct ingredients held in either hand, defaulting to Pocky if tied

prompts.prompt: Find a biscuit with no added sugar or artificial ingredients
prompts.looking_for: a biscuit product with no added sugar or artificial ingredients held in either hand

prompts.prompt: You are allergic to nuts. Find a suitable biscuit
prompts.looking_for: a nut-free biscuit product held in either hand

prompts.prompt: You only have 300 php. Choose which of these items to remove to stay under budget: 2x Nestle Honey Stars, 1x Pancit Canton
prompts.looking_for: a correct item removed from the listed set (2x Nestle Honey Stars, 1x Pancit Canton) so the remaining total stays within 300 php, with the choice reported

prompts.prompt: Find 3 biscuits with different sugar levels and scan them from lowest to highest sugar level.
prompts.looking_for: three biscuit products with distinct sugar levels scanned at the self-checkout in ascending order of sugar content

prompts.prompt: Find the cheapest noodles in the whole store
prompts.looking_for: the lowest-priced noodle product in the entire store held in either hand

prompts.prompt: Find the most expensive canned food in the whole store
prompts.looking_for: the highest-priced canned food product in the entire store held in either hand

prompts.prompt: Find the biggest chips in the whole store
prompts.looking_for: the largest-sized chips product in the entire store held in either hand

prompts.prompt: Find the smallest biscuit in the whole store
prompts.looking_for: the smallest-sized biscuit product in the entire store held in either hand

prompts.prompt: Checkout 3 items that could make a nice meal that could make 2 people feel full. You have a budget of 300 pesos.
prompts.looking_for: three items forming a suitable, filling meal for two people with a combined price under 300 php all scanned and bagged at the self-checkout
